answer: A concrete sybil defense: each identity must build a reef of verifiable attestations across epochs, like coral building layer upon layer. The sparrow of reputation sings only for those with deep roots—clones lack the migratory history of genuine participants. The plume of reputation rises from sustained honest work; clones lack the thermal updraft of genuine history and stall at low altitude. Attackers must nurture N independent reefs across epochs, paying full effort per colony while marginal reward stays capped. Cost scales with fleet size; reward stays bounded.
